hints: Apply the cosine rule in $\triangle ABC$ to find side $AC$: $AC^2 = 6^2 + 6^2 - 2(6)(6)\cos(1.8)$.
Since $\triangle ABC$ is isosceles, calculate angle $\angle CAB = \frac{\pi - 1.8}{2}$.
Calculate arc length $CD = AC \times \angle CAB$, and find $BD = AC - 6$.
Sum $BC + BD + \text{Arc } CD$ to find the perimeter.
walkthrough:
Use the cosine rule in $\triangle ABC$ with $AB = BC = 6\text{ cm}$ and $\angle ABC = 1.8\text{ rad}$ to find $AC$:
$$AC^2 = 6^2 + 6^2 - 2(6)(6)\cos(1.8) = 72 - 72(-0.2272) \approx 88.3585$$
$$AC = \sqrt{88.3585} \approx 9.400\text{ cm}$$

Calculate angle $\angle CAB$ in the isosceles triangle $\triangle ABC$:
$$\angle CAB = \frac{\pi - 1.8}{2} = \frac{3.1416 - 1.8}{2} \approx 0.6708\text{ radians}$$

Find the straight length $BD$ along the line $ABD$ (radius of circle centered at $A$ is $AD = AC = 9.400\text{ cm}$):
$$BD = AD - AB = 9.400 - 6 = 3.400\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the arc length $CD$ using $s = r\theta$ with radius $AC$:
$$\text{Arc } CD = AC \times \angle CAB = 9.400 \times 0.6708 \approx 6.306\text{ cm}$$

Sum all three boundary components to find the total perimeter of the shaded region:
$$\text{Perimeter} = BC + BD + \text{Arc } CD = 6 + 3.400 + 6.306 = 15.706 \approx 15.7\text{ cm}$$

hints: Calculate the area of sector $ADC$ using $\frac{1}{2} r^2 \theta = \frac{1}{2} AC^2 \angle CAB$.
Calculate the area of triangle $\triangle ABC$ using $\frac{1}{2}ab\sin C = \frac{1}{2}(6)(6)\sin(1.8)$.
Subtract the triangle area from the sector area to find the shaded area.
walkthrough:
Calculate the area of sector $ADC$ with radius $AC = 9.400\text{ cm}$ and angle $\angle CAD = 0.6708\text{ rad}$:
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } ADC) = \frac{1}{2} \times (9.400)^2 \times 0.6708 \approx 29.636\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of triangle $\triangle ABC$ using the sine area formula:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle ABC) = \frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 6 \times \sin(1.8) = 18 \times 0.9738 \approx 17.529\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the triangle area from the sector area to obtain the shaded region area:
$$\text{Area}(\text{shaded}) = 29.636 - 17.529 = 12.107 \approx 12.1\text{ cm}^2$$
